goal: Prevent a node crash when calling dumptxoutset with rollback on a pruned node after loading a snapshot
Return a clear RPC error instead of aborting when tip block and undo data have not downloaded yet
agreement: Objections settled but nobody has spoken in favor yet
Questioned whether fixing this esoteric edge case is worth review effort (fjahr)
Requested a more accurate error message when tip block data is missing (fjahr)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it prevents an assertion crash terminating the daemon during dumptxoutset rollback
Limited to a narrow edge case on pruned nodes right after loading an assumeutxo snapshot
